documents.title: Service policy
documents.text: Prep and local delivery are for Las Vegas residents only. We ship dry lyophilized vials only — not reconstituted product. Educational information only. The team calls to confirm, consult, and complete required documentation before payment.

documents.title: Locked information sheets
documents.text: Each live SKU has a locked information sheet as a Telegram file. Tap Sheet. Mix, starting amounts, and syringe marks live on that PDF — not in chat. Shop pages in Links are not the sheets.

documents.title: Payment
documents.text: Local Las Vegas: Zelle is best. The team shares Zelle details on the confirmation call. Prefer debit card? Tap Team, then Debit. Telegram interest orders are for Las Vegas residents only.

documents.title: Sales and discounts
documents.text: The floor team never invents a sale. A promotion appears only after TrueHold staff approve it case by case. If no approved promo is on file, there is no sale.

documents.title: No dosing in chat
documents.text: This host does not provide dosing, reconstitution, injection, or medical advice in chat. Tap Sheet for the locked PDF, or Team to talk with a person. Respect the tools.

documents.title: Why we are here
documents.text: We care that people get healthy and take control of their own lives. Use the tools nature and God already gave us. High-quality food and rest make a high-quality human. Peptides can help you aim at your best health. Educational only. If you support this house, tell others.

documents.title: Nature, science, and memory
documents.text: These signals showed up in bone broths, herbs, and fermentation long before lab glass. A lot of that kitchen knowledge was lost. Science opened the door again — like seeing it for the first time. Most peptides already exist in the human body. They are naturally occurring. You have a right to know. Mix math stays on the locked sheet, not in chat.

documents.title: Respect, not control
documents.text: Too much of anything — even oxygen — can seriously hurt you. TrueHold Wellness agrees: these are tools to respect, not toys and not a hostage. We will not dose in chat. We will not hide the truth. Learn. Do not lose access.

documents.title: Vitamin C is not a hostage
documents.text: It is like holding vitamin C hostage and saying someone else must control how many oranges you may have. We must learn, but not at the expense of losing access. Leave naturally occurring tools with the people. Stop profiteers from locking them up for profit — and from corrupting them later. The people deserve the truth.

documents.title: What you put in
documents.text: Empowerment means taking ownership of your body. What you put in produces the human you are. High-quality food and rest equal a high-quality human. We have a right to pursue our best health. Peptides are one of the tools that can help. Educational information. Las Vegas, dry vials, team consult for orders.
